title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Themeisle MPG……
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Themeisle MPG (multiple-pages-generator-by-porthas) affecting versions up to 4.2.6. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in users' browsers. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
